create.name: Rosie Acosta
create.bio:
Rosie Acosta is a mindfulness and yoga teacher from East Los Angeles who teaches in English and Spanish. Her own hard early years led her to yoga and meditation, and she has spent close to two decades studying them: mindfulness-based stress reduction at Oregon Health & Science University, a trauma-informed yoga training with Hala Khouri, and more than 5,800 hours of teaching as a senior registered yoga teacher. She founded the MindfulFlow yoga and meditation teacher trainings, records guided practices for Headspace, and has appeared on the cover of Yoga Journal.

Her book You Are Radically Loved (Tarcher, 2022) follows her own story through meditations, journaling prompts and practices for self-love and honesty with oneself. She now works mostly as a mindfulness-based coach, meeting people online one to one around stress, burnout, anxious thinking, sleep and big transitions, with a strand of work on the emotional side of perimenopause and midlife; she is clear that this sits alongside medical care rather than replacing it. She hosts The Radically Well Podcast with Tessa Tovar, speaks to companies, and keeps a free library of her guided meditations and yoga nidra on her site.

books.title: You Are Radically Loved: A Healing Journey to Self-Love
books.author: Rosie Acosta
books.description: Built around her own life story, the book offers meditations, journaling questions and everyday spiritual practices for self-acceptance, honesty and resilience. Published by Tarcher in 2022.

courses.title: Mindfulness-Based Coaching
courses.description: Private online coaching in English or Spanish that pairs mindfulness and nervous-system practices with practical coaching for stress, burnout, anxious thinking and life transitions. After an initial free call, clients book single sessions or programmes of three to six months.

courses.title: Perimenopause & Menopause Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one online coaching for the emotional side of the midlife transition, using mindfulness practices, pattern tracking and help preparing for conversations at home and with doctors. Her page states plainly that it is not medical care or therapy.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra for Sleep
free_resources.description: Her most played practice, a 26-minute guided yoga nidra to use in bed at night or after waking in the small hours, with notes on how to get the most from it.

free_resources.title: Free Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A free library of her recorded practices, grouped into short pauses, sleep and deep rest, grounding for busy minds, and loving-kindness, with no sign-up.
